general.name: Time Sync - Clock Offset Exceeds Threshold [Lin]
general.description:
Alerts when the clock is not synchronised, or is more than a set number of seconds off NTP time, per chronyd, ntpd or systemd-timesyncd. Read-only.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Monitors/time-sync-clock-offset-exceeds-threshold-lin

variables.name: usrThreshold
variables.description: Whole seconds, 1-86400. Alerts when the clock is more than this off NTP time.
